rules.A_tsmom12: each month end: position = sign(12-month return); hold one month (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen 2012)
rules.B_trend_ensemble: each month end: position = mean of sign(1-month), sign(3-month), sign(12-month) returns, in [-1, 1] (Hurst-Ooi-Pedersen style)

unit: R = position x next-month return / trailing 60-day daily volatility x sqrt(21)
costs: spread floor per trade on the position change + 5%/yr financing on |position|, charged whichever side (conservative for CFDs)
pass: mean R > 0 in BOTH samples and pooled t >= 2 per group (only 2 rules x 4 groups are tested)
caveat: Yahoo futures are continuous front-month, not back-adjusted: roll gaps bias energy most (contango), gold little
